Browser click x/y use viewport CSS pixels; default device scale is 1. Estimate target center as fractions of this complete image width/height and convert to native pixels; do not use normalized 0..1000 coordinates or invent offsets. If model image preprocessing rescales the image, preserve the fractions and map back to the native dimensions above. Use full_page=false for clicking. Identify target from pixels, click once, then take and load a NEW screenshot to verify actual state change. After a miss re-estimate from fresh pixels; never repeat an unchanged failed coordinate. Stop after at most 4 clicks without success and report the limitation honestly. Never infer success from a click return alone.
